items.title: Defense Forces strike Russian Buk-M3 air defense system in Zaporizhzhia region and UAV launch site near Donetsk
items.teaser: On October 3 and during the night of October 4, units of the Ukrainian Armed Forces struck a number of key military targets belonging to the Russian invaders, including a “Buk-M3” air defense system in the Zaporizhzhia region and a storage and launch site for attack drones in the Donetsk area.

items.title: Merz in Kiew: "Auf unsere Hilfe könnt ihr weiter zählen"
items.teaser: Bei einem Besuch in Kiew bekräftigt Friedrich Merz die deutsche Unterstützung für die Ukraine, es soll neue Militärhilfe geben. Vor einer Ruine appelliert der Kanzler an Putin.

items.title: Zelenskyy announces important agreements with Germany amid chancellor's visit
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced upcoming defence agreements with Germany amid Chancellor Friedrich Merz's visit to Kyiv.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian Buk-M3 and drone launch site, General Staff reports
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has reported strikes on a Russian Buk-M3 missile system, a drone launch site near Donetsk and telecom hubs.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia used more than 1,900 drones, 1,700 aerial bombs and 25 missiles against Ukraine in one week
items.teaser: Over the past week, Russia has launched more than 1,900 attack drones, 1,700 aerial bombs, and 25 missiles at Ukraine.

items.title: KAB strikes on Sumy kill one person and injure 13, including child
items.teaser: In Sumy, one person was killed and 13 others were wounded, including a child, as a result of guided airstrikes.

items.title: Selenskyj und Merz gedenken gefallener Verteidiger der Ukraine
items.teaser: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz und der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj gedachten der gefallenen ukrainischen Verteidiger und Verteidigerinnen.

items.title: All EU member state embassies remain in Kyiv, EU ambassador to Ukraine says
items.teaser: EU Ambassador Katarína Mathernová says all 25 EU member states with embassies in Kyiv will keep their diplomatic missions operating in the Ukrainian capital despite Moscow’s warnings of further attacks.

items.title: Ukraine: Kanzler Merz in Kyjiw - Drohne trifft Nordbrücke
items.teaser: Ungeachtet neuer Drohungen aus Russland sind Bundeskanzler Merz und Wirtschaftsministerin Reiche nach Kyjiw gereist. Kurz nach ihrer Ankunft in der Hauptstadt der Ukraine beschädigt eine Drohne eine Brücke.

items.title: Guided bombs strike on Sumy injures seven, damages gas networks and business facility
items.teaser: In Sumy, seven people were injured and gas networks and a business were damaged as a result of guided airstrikes.

items.title: Russian attacks on Sumy kill man and injure 16 people, including baby – photo
items.teaser: Three drones and four guided aerial bombs struck Sumy on 4 October, damaging residential buildings, a car shop, municipal infrastructure and around 25 vehicles.

items.title: Wegen FlyDubai-Anschlag - SPD-Menschenrechtler pestet gegen Prien und Israel
items.teaser: Menschenrechtsbeauftragter attackiert Prien nach Kritik an Reaktion auf Terrorplot

items.title: Bombenangriff auf Sumy: Ein Todesopfer, 13 Verletzte, darunter ein Kind
items.teaser: Am Morgen, 4. Oktober wurden auf die Studt Sumy gelenkte Fliegerbomben abgeworfen. Ein Mensch kam ums Leben.

items.title: "Wir haben sie angeschrien": Passagiere: Flydubai-Crew forderte Freilassung des Copiloten
items.teaser: Gemeinsam mit dem indischen Piloten verhindern die Passagiere von Flydubai-Flug 1073 einen Terroranschlag des Copiloten. Doch nachdem dieser überwältigt ist, bricht an Bord offenbar ein Streit mit der übrigen Crew aus. Die Flugbegleiter werden anschließend vom Cockpit entfernt.

items.title: Russia’s drones keep targeting the bridges Kyiv can’t easily replace—now the Northern crossing is cratered
items.teaser: Ukraine's government is already weighing earth dams and pontoon crossings in case the city's Dnipro bridges are knocked out.

items.title: Moscow trains its military pilots at Khanskaya. Locals report a fire there after drones attacked overnight
items.teaser: NASA fire data confirmed a blaze in the airfield's area, though the damage is still unknown.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Merz besucht Kiew - Russland greift Brücke an
items.teaser: Während Kanzler Merz Kiew besucht, hat ein russischer Angriff auf eine Brücke dort Alarm ausgelöst. Merz sagte dem Land Unterstützung zu und trifft sich mit Präsident Selenskyj. Russland begehe "tägliche Kriegsverbrechen".

items.title: Russian attack damages heating main in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district
items.teaser: In Kyiv’s Desnianskyi District, a heating main was damaged as a result of a Russian attack, causing a temporary interruption in the hot water supply.

items.title: Bombenangriff auf Sumy: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf sieben
items.teaser: Auf die Studt Sumy wurden gelenkte Fliegerbomben abgeworfen.

items.title: "Gerade Explosionen am Himmel", Susanne Petersohn, ARD Kiew, zu Merz-Besuch in Kiew
items.teaser: "Gerade Explosionen am Himmel", Susanne Petersohn, ARD Kiew, zu Merz-Besuch in Kiew

items.title: Russia targets Kyiv bridges for fourth consecutive day, hits Northern Bridge
items.teaser: From Oct. 1 to Oct. 3, Kyiv's Southern and Northern bridges were targeted in multiple Russian drone strikes amid an intensifying campaign against infrastructure in the capital.

items.title: Russian drone strike damages road surface on Kyiv's North Bridge
items.teaser: In Kyiv, a Russian drone was reported to have struck the road surface on the Northern Bridge.

items.title: Zelenskyy posts video of strike on Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge
items.teaser: Zelenskyy posted footage of a Russian drone strike on Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge and announced defence agreements with Germany's Merz.

items.title: Finland investigates alleged war crime committed in Ukraine
items.teaser: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation is probing an alleged war crime committed in Ukraine, a rare case for Finnish law enforcement.

items.title: Latvia election: Pro-Ukraine PM Kulbergs set to retain power after historic victory for his United List party
items.teaser: Latvia's prime minister, Andris Kulbergs, looks set to retain power after his party appeared to score the country's biggest election victory since independence.

items.title: Luftabwehr macht 123 russische Drohnen und zwei Banderols unschädlich
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 123von 135 Drohnen neutralisiert, womit die russischen Besatzer seit Samstagabend, am 3. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hatten.

items.title: Ein legendärer Spionagejet ist von einem Stützpunkt verschwunden. Die Nasa gibt keine Erklärung ab
items.teaser: Die berühmte SR-71 Blackbird galt seit Jahren als Museumsstück unter freiem Himmel. Nun ist das Flugzeug weg – und die Nasa gibt keine Erklärung ab.

items.title: Russian forces shell Donetsk region settlements 17 times in past 24 hours, causing casualties
items.teaser: In the Donetsk region, Russian troops shelled settlements in the region 17 times over the past 24 hours, wounding two people.

items.title: German politicians call former chancellor Schröder's new position in Russia a "betrayal"
items.teaser: German politicians and economists criticised ex-chancellor Gerhard Schröder's new position at Russian retailer Globus as a "betrayal".

items.title: Russische Drohne trifft Nordbrücke in Kyjiw
items.teaser: Eine russische Drohne habe am Morgen, 4. Oktober die Fahrbahn auf der Nordbrücke in Kyjiw getroffen.

items.title: Kyiv now feels like a front-line city — but its resolve is holding, for now
items.teaser: For much of Russia's full-scale war, massive attacks on Kyiv came mainly at night. Residents learned, as much as possible, to organize their lives around them. items.title: Germany's Merz visits Kyiv as Russia strikes bridge
items.teaser: A Kyiv bridge was hit by a Russian drone shortly after Chancellor Merz arrived in the Ukrainian capital. During his visit, Merz is set to announce new measures to support Ukraine, including plans for drone production.

items.title: Russian attack damages heating main in Kyiv: Desnianskyi district left without hot water
items.teaser: A Russian strike damaged a heating main in Kyiv, leaving the Desnianskyi district without hot water; crews work on repairs.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,540,700 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,750 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: NG troops deliver nearly four metric tons of humanitarian aid to Oleshky for second time
items.teaser: Soldiers from the 11th Mykhailo Hrushevsky Brigade and the 34th Kherson Regiment of the Ukrainian National Guard carried out a successful operation for the second time last night to deliver humanitarian aid to the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 204 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: Am 3. Oktober kam es zu 4 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front. Die Mehrheit davon wurde Richtung Pokrowsk gemeldet.

items.title: Ukrainian troops deliver four tonnes of humanitarian aid to occupied Oleshky again – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces delivered nearly four tonnes of food and medicine to occupied Oleshky via drones, while also evacuating six animals.

items.title: Partisans destroy communications tower with EW system in Voronezh region
items.teaser: Agents of the ATESH partisan movement disabled a communications tower with an electronic warfare system installed on it near the village of Podgornoye in Russia's Rossosh district, Voronezh region.

items.title: Air defense intercepts 123 drones, two Banderols used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 123 of the 135 drones and two Banderols used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine from the evening of October 3.

items.title: Russian forces strike Sumy with guided bombs: five injured
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the Sumy hromada A hromada is an administrative unit designating a village, several villages, or a town, and their adjacent territories. with five guided aerial bombs on the morning of 4 October. At least five people have been injured, two of whom are reported to have sustained serious injuries.

items.title: Ukraine marks Territorial Defense Day
items.teaser: Ukraine is marking Territorial Defense Day on Sunday, October 4.

items.title: German Chancellor Merz arrives in Kyiv, pledges further support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Merz was accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and 10 executives from Germany's defense and energy sectors.

items.title: War update: 204 combat clashes on front lines in past day, most on Pokrovsk axis
items.teaser: As many as 204 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front line on October 3, with the highest number occurring on the Pokrovsk axis.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert innerhalb eines Tages 1750 weitere Besatzer
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 4. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.540.700 Soldaten. Innerhalb eines Tages wurden 1150 weitere Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Drone debris falls at two locations in Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district
items.teaser: Drone debris fell onto the roof of a private house in Kyiv's Dniprovskyi district, while debris was also found near a road.

items.title: Russians attack telecoms company in central Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian forces struck central Dnipro on the morning of 4 October, causing a fire.

items.title: German chancellor arrives in Kyiv on surprise visit
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived by train in the Ukrainian capital on Sunday, October 4, for an unannounced visit.

items.title: Bundeskanzler Merz in Kyjiw eingetroffen
items.teaser: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz ist am Sonntag, 4. Oktober zu einem unangekündigten Besuch in Kyjiw eingetroffen.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 135 drones: hits recorded at five locations
items.teaser: Russia attacked Ukraine with 135 drones overnight; air defence shot down or jammed 123 of them, with hits recorded at five locations.

items.title: „Koalition mit der Linken wäre der Sargnagel für die SPD“: Leser warnen vor Bündnis in Berlin
items.teaser: Leser streiten über die Linke, den Verfassungsschutz und die Folgen möglicher Koalitionen in Berlin.

items.title: Germany's Merz arrives in Kyiv to pledge more support
items.teaser: Chancellor Friedrich Merz is expected to announce a new raft of measures to support Ukraine, including military aid and plans for the joint production of interceptor drones.

items.title: German chancellor arrives in Kyiv
items.teaser: Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv, pledging interceptor drones and long-range weapons support as part of Germany's continued backing for Ukraine.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,750 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 4, 2026, have reached approximately 1,540,700 personnel, including 1,750 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Merz überraschend zu Ukraine-Besuch in Kiew eingetroffen
items.teaser: Friedrich Merz reist nach Kiew, um Deutschlands Unterstützung zu bekräftigen. Eine Milliarde Euro fließt in Waffen, weitere 350 Millionen in die Energieversorgung.

items.title: Russian Defence Ministry claims over 550 Ukrainian drones attacked Russia overnight
items.teaser: Russia's Defence Ministry claims air defences intercepted 559 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions, Crimea and Black Sea.

items.title: Russian forces shell 47 settlements in Zaporizhzhia region over past day
items.teaser: Over the past 24 hours, Russian forces launched 745 attacks on 47 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region. Two people were injured in enemy shelling of the Zaporizhzhia district.

items.title: U.S. peace negotiations with Russia could now involve multi-billion dollar Lukoil deal, NYT reports
items.teaser: The Trump administration’s peace negotiations with the Kremlin have come to include discussions of a multi-billion dollar deal involving assets owned by Russian oil company Lukoil, the New York Times (NYT) reported on Oct. 3.

items.title: Izium hit by large-caliber multiple rocket launchers
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the city of Izium in the Kharkiv region with large-caliber multiple rocket launchers, sparking a fire and damaging houses.

items.title: Terror-Miliz veröffentlicht Schreiben - Al-Qaida ruft zu neuen Flugzeug-Attacken auf
items.teaser: Al-Qaida-Anhänger feiern den Flydubai-Angriff und fordern neue Flugzeugattacken.

items.title: Russian drones attack Kyiv: debris falls on roof of house in Dniprovskyi district
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked Kyiv repeatedly overnight and on the morning of 4 October, causing a fire at a non-residential building in the Desnianskyi district. Debris also fell onto the roof of a house in the Dniprovskyi district.

items.title: Russia has reduced use of ballistic missiles ahead of winter – Dutch analyst
items.teaser: Dutch analyst Patrick Bolder believes that Russia is currently using fewer ballistic missiles in its attacks on Ukraine and is carrying out a significant proportion of its strikes with jet-powered drones, apparently saving ballistic missiles for further use during the winter.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Kanzler Merz besucht Kiew
items.teaser: Bundeskanzler Merz ist zu einem Solidaritätsbesuch in Kiew eingetroffen. Dabei soll es auch um weitere militärische Unterstützung gehen. Zuvor hatte Russland vor Reisen in die Ukraine gewarnt.

items.title: Dutch writer: I was trying to show Netherlands what Ukraine is like just as war began
items.teaser: Dutch writer of Ukrainian descent Lisa Weeda called it an "absolutely crazy situation" that she had to show people Ukraine, one of Europe's largest countries, at precisely the time when a war was raging there.

items.title: More than 3,800 marriages registered in Ukraine last week – Justice Ministry
items.teaser: More than 3,800 marriages were registered in Ukraine last week, with the highest number of marriages recorded in Kyiv.

items.title: Russia loses 1,750 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,750 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Fragments from drone debris cause fire at non-residential building in Kyiv
items.teaser: A fire broke out at a non-residential building in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district as a result of falling drone debris.

items.title: At least 15,000 civilian casualties documented in Ukraine in 2026, UN report finds
items.teaser: The UN Human Rights Office found that an average of more than 400 civilians were killed or injured every week in Ukraine during the first eight months of 2026, a 55% increase from the same period in 2025, High Commissioner Volker Turk told the Human Rights Council in Geneva on Oct. 2.
